start.text: Trolley empty, saar. The aisle is that side — follow the arrows. Everyone tries to skip the arrows.

checkout.text: All scanned. Three boxes on the metro, saar. Four if you are brave. Blue bag for the small things?

bag.text: Big blue bag. You will use it for everything except furniture. Exit is through that lane — the Green Line is across the road.

nobag.text: Strong arms. Exit is through that lane — the Green Line is across the road.

paid.text: Already paid, saar. The metro is that side. Good luck with the doors.
